$comment: English image-model prompts for the fixture photos (tools/eval/src/fixtures/ai-photos.ts). Keys are <fixture id>/<NN>; the subject in brief.json is the source. Fixtures are fiction and never reach a client site. `style` is appended to every prompt.
style: Realistic photograph taken with a good smartphone by the owner of a small business in Slovenia, for their own website. Natural available light, unstaged, true-to-life colours, ordinary everyday setting with small imperfections. No text, no lettering on signs or packaging, no logos, no watermark, no borders.

photos.avtoservis-mrak/01: A mid-size family car raised on a two-post lift in a small, tidy independent car repair workshop; tool trolley and tyres in the background, fluorescent ceiling light mixed with daylight from an open roller door.
photos.avtoservis-mrak/02: A mechanic in dark work overalls leaning over the open bonnet of a car, inspecting the engine with a torch; hands visible, face partly turned away, workshop in soft focus behind.
photos.avtoservis-mrak/03: A metal storage rack stacked with sets of car tyres in a workshop storeroom, each set grouped together, concrete floor, daylight from a side window.
photos.fizioterapija-pregib/01: A padded physiotherapy treatment table with a fresh paper sheet in a bright, simple treatment room; a large window with daylight, a wall bar and a few exercise balls and resistance bands on a shelf.
photos.frizerstvo-lana/01: Interior of a small neighbourhood hair salon with two styling chairs facing large mirrors, a shelf of products between them, a plant, daylight from the shop window.
photos.frizerstvo-lana/02: A hairdresser cutting the medium-length hair of a seated client with scissors and a comb, seen from the side in a small salon; the client wears a cutting cape, calm everyday moment.
photos.frizerstvo-lana/03: Long hair with soft balayage highlights seen from behind, freshly styled, the client sitting in a salon chair; shallow depth of field.
photos.frizerstvo-lana/04: An elegant wedding updo with braids and small pins seen from behind and slightly to the side, the bride's shoulders visible, soft window light in a salon.
photos.frizerstvo-lana/05: A wooden shelf in a hair salon with unbranded bottles of shampoo and hair care products, a pair of hairdressing scissors and a comb lying in front.
photos.gostilna-zlata-zlica/01: Front of an old traditional Slovenian inn (gostilna) in a small town near Škofja Loka: whitewashed two-storey house with green wooden shutters, a large old linden tree in front of the entrance, a few wooden benches; summer afternoon.
photos.gostilna-zlata-zlica/02: Dining room of a traditional Slovenian inn with solid wooden tables covered with white tablecloths, wooden chairs, wood-panelled walls and a tiled stove in the corner, daylight through small windows.
photos.gostilna-zlata-zlica/03: A plate of Slovenian buckwheat žganci topped with crispy pork cracklings (ocvirki), on a wooden inn table, a glass of sour milk beside it; homely, not styled like a magazine.
photos.gostilna-zlata-zlica/04: Rolled walnut štruklji (Slovenian boiled dumpling rolls) sliced into rounds on a plain white plate, drizzled with melted butter and toasted breadcrumbs, on a restaurant table.
photos.gostilna-zlata-zlica/05: Terrace of a country inn under a big linden tree, tables laid with checked tablecloths and chairs, dappled sunlight through the leaves.
photos.gostilna-zlata-zlica/06: A bowl of Slovenian veal ragout soup (telečja obara) with carrots and small pieces of meat, a slice of bread and a spoon beside it on a wooden table.
photos.gostilna-zlata-zlica/07: A cook in a white jacket stirring a pot on a stove in a small, busy inn kitchen; steam rising, pans hanging, seen from the side.
photos.gostilna-zlata-zlica/08: A long table set for a family celebration in an inn dining room: white tablecloth, wine glasses partly filled with red wine, folded napkins, a small bunch of field flowers.
photos.kmetija-grabnar/01: An alpine farmhouse in the Upper Savinja valley with a long wooden balcony full of red geraniums, a steep meadow in front and forested mountains behind, clear summer morning.
photos.kmetija-grabnar/02: A guest room on a tourist farm with two simple wooden beds covered in red-and-white checked bedding, pine-panelled walls and a small window looking onto green hills.
photos.kmetija-grabnar/03: A farm breakfast on a wooden table: homemade cheese, fresh cottage cheese, a jar of jam, a loaf of bread, butter and a jug of milk, morning light from a window.
photos.kmetija-grabnar/04: A few brown-and-white cows grazing on a steep alpine pasture with mountains behind, late afternoon light.
photos.kmetija-grabnar/05: A slice of homemade apple strudel dusted with icing sugar on a simple plate on a wooden farm table.
photos.kmetija-grabnar/06: Two children seen from behind feeding goats over a wooden fence on a farm, green meadow and mountains in the background, faces not visible.
photos.kmetija-grabnar/07: View from a farmhouse terrace with a wooden railing across a green mountain valley with scattered farms and forest, morning haze.
photos.kmetija-grabnar/08: A wooden shelf in a farm pantry with rows of glass jars of homemade jam in different colours, checked cloth covers on the lids, no labels.
photos.pekarna-kvas/01: Round sourdough loaves with a dark, crackly crust and flour-dusted scoring, stacked on rustic wooden shelves behind the counter of a small bakery.
photos.pekarna-kvas/02: A baker shaping a ball of sourdough on a floured wooden workbench, close on the hands and forearms, flour on the table, early morning light in the bakery.
photos.pekarna-kvas/03: A metal baking tray with golden croissants and cinnamon rolls fresh from the oven on a bakery counter.
photos.trgovina-oljka-in-sol/01: Shelves in a small delicatessen with rows of unlabelled glass bottles of golden olive oil, light coming through them from a window, wooden shelving.
photos.trgovina-oljka-in-sol/02: Small cloth and paper bags of coarse sea salt from the Piran salt pans in a woven wooden basket on a shop counter, plain bags with no lettering.
photos.trgovina-oljka-in-sol/03: A gift box with a bottle of olive oil, a small bag of sea salt and a jar of honey, nestled in wood wool on a wooden table, no labels or lettering.
photos.trgovina-oljka-in-sol/04: The entrance to a small shop in an old stone house in the historic centre of Koper, a wooden door, a few potted plants and a bench outside, narrow Mediterranean street.
photos.trgovina-oljka-in-sol/05: A deli counter with thin slices of Karst prosciutto and wedges of cheese on wooden boards, a knife beside them.
photos.zobozdravstvo-lebar/01: A bright, clean dental surgery with a modern dental chair, a lamp above it and white cabinets, daylight from a large window.
photos.zobozdravstvo-lebar/02: A small dental waiting room with a row of green chairs, a potted plant and a low wooden side table with a glass water jug and cups, nothing printed in view, calm and bright.
photos.zobozdravstvo-lebar/03: A dentist in a white coat and mask examining a patient's teeth in a dental chair, seen from the side, the patient's face mostly hidden by the dentist's hands and the lamp.
